title: MCP Servers
description: Codex starts two stdio MCP servers from config before the loop. Discovered tools are exposed as mcp__<server>__<tool>. The model has no connect_mcp tool.

steps.annotation: Codex reads config.toml and starts the children before agentLoop. The model has no connect_mcp tool.

steps.content: docs: initialize → tools/list → search, get_page · deploy: trigger
steps.annotation: stdio JSON-RPC, newline-delimited. Protocol on stdout, logs on stderr.
mcp__ is Codex's legacy prefix. tools/call uses the raw name (search, not mcp__docs__search).

steps.content: Find the agent-loop note, read it, then deploy staging.
steps.annotation: Same loop as s01. The model only sees ordinary function tools.
The bridge translates this to tools/call { name: "search" } on the docs child.
Second call on the same child. The loop did not change.
A second server. (destructive) is a teaching hint — real Codex still runs approval_policy (s03).

steps.content: Answered via three bridged MCP tools across two child-process servers. The agent never knew they were external processes.
steps.annotation: function_call_output is appended like any other tool result.
